datePolicy: All source access dates retain original November 7, 2026 observations. Publication dates and advertised availability dates are separate; unknown publication dates remain unknown in retainedDateNote. Copy authoring is not a freshness check. Original run model and publication date remain unknown. No 2027 payroll rates, Mietspiegel edition or rental availability invented.
uncertainties: Eight furnished examples all from FARAWAYHOME, not a representative platform/market survey. Source-authored publication dates unknown; full February dates, authority, total fees and provider-confirmation delivery unverified.

Unpriced energy charges and visiting-friend clauses need written clarification. No tenant commission does not establish zero administration/tax/broadcast/key/document/cleaning fees. Deposit subtotals are liquidity, not verified invoices or legal category rulings.

Long-term evidence partial: only Mahlsdorf has independent 1-room and 2-room asks. Wilmersdorf is same-building two-unit evidence; Adlershof aggregator partial; Lankwitz and Wedding deleted historical context. No four/five-area statistical ranges or unrestricted WBS eligibility claimed.

Wilmersdorf lease terms and larger third-party original offer unverified; smaller unit has no kitchen and AI visualisations. Lankwitz cold-price conflict unresolved; Wedding size and cold-label conflicts retained.

Mietspiegel conditional net-cold cells are not available asking rents, matched unit appraisals or automatic legal ceilings. Original official PDF correction followed, not initial mirror cells; no new PDF fetch.

Brazilian applicant unchanged: nationality, qualification and work-permission status still require individual confirmation. 2026 Blue Card thresholds do not certify 2027 eligibility. Registration alone is not work authorisation.

Monthly net is 2026 class I/TK/childless/no-church/no-benefits model, not actual 2027 payroll; being alone does not determine children or church-tax status. Employer payday/cutoff, bank approval, tax-ID delivery and annual tax outcome unknown.

Landing cash assumes February 8 arrival, March 31 first pay and two rolling rent periods. Third-rent pre-payday and April 30 salary-delay cases separate; permanent move, kitchen/furniture and overlapping deposits/rent extra. Insurance/work-start delays may require more.

No new browser/render/build/publication or external research. Pure local literal/table/hash/arithmetic checks do not certify current laws, prices, landlords, eligibility, availability or visual rendering.
editingContract: Only new assigned en/zh Markdown, semantic data and scoped batch25 notes. No source edits, shared code/inventory/README/manifest changes, builds, network, publication or contact. No ratings, Review or AggregateRating.
